spans.s:
(त) r. 1st cl. (ओजति)
1 To live, to have the vital faculties and organs.
2 To be strong or able.

Support, stay.
5 Metallic lustre.
6 Vitality, the principle of vital warmth and action diffused throughout the body.
7 Virility, the generative faculty.
8 A form of style, elaborate style, abounding with compounds.
9 (In astrology,) Each alternate sign of the zodiac, first, third, fifth, &c.
E.
ओज to live, and असुन् affix; or with अच् affix ओज.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
1 Mighty, powerful, strong.
2 Splendid, bright.
E.
आजस्, and विनि aff.
